tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair required context file and byte budgets refuse before dispatch
decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair reuses a patch slot after restoring the first file
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair required context file and byte budgets refuse before dispatch' --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair reuses a patch slot after restoring the first file'

scope.claim: The active repair loop refuses a two-file required context under independently isolated maximumContextFiles=1 and maximumContextBytes=one byte below the exact combined bytes. Both refusals occur before harness dispatch and preserve accepted source/head, leave no pending attempt, and record RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. The same run rechecks active ACP patch-slot reuse after exact restoration of the first file.
limitations: Context admission cases use a strict captured test harness and intentionally do not launch ACP after pre-dispatch refusal.
Local evidence only; no live provider, successful production validation under #236, other profiles, hosted exact-head CI, or complete #734/#63 acceptance.
